findings.title: Weak assertions vs. stated intent
findings.message: The context-menu phase of the test asserts the camera is unchanged, but the secondary-button click is at the viewport center, which may be handled differently. It also never confirms the cube-click phase made no model command, even though the comment says so; only selections is checked. The test also hard-fails with t.Fatal and no distinct message for each condition, which makes failures hard to diagnose.
findings.suggestion: Split the assertions into separate checks with distinct messages. Add a check for model commands/history if the comment's claim is to be verified.
